name: BCIE
body: HSTS runs a full year, DMARC is enforced, framing is limited, and every image has alt text. But a made-up address answers 200 instead of 404, so crawlers can index error pages as real ones.
lesson: Return a real 404 status for unknown paths, with a helpful page, so search engines drop dead URLs.
summary: www.bcie.org scores 73 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 21 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 21 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /transparencia-e-integridad, /transparencia-e-integridad/acceso-a-la-informacion, /transparencia-e-integridad/etica-institucional and 13 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 2 titles are shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "BCIE" on /, /transparencia-e-integridad, /transparencia-e-integridad/acceso-a-la-informacion and 14 more. "Sitio en Mantenimiento - BCIE" on /quienes-somos/sostenibilidad/mecanismo-de-reclamos-y-quejas, /transparencia-e-integridad/evaluacion-independiente,…
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 3 pages have no measurement tag while the start page does
fix.evidence: /quienes-somos/sostenibilidad/mecanismo-de-reclamos-y-quejas, /transparencia-e-integridad/evaluacion-independiente, /publicaciones-economicas. Visits to those pages are invisible in the reports.
fix.fix: Load the same tag from the shared layout on every page.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia-e-integridad, /transparencia-e-integridad/acceso-a-la-informacion, /transparencia-e-integridad/etica-institucional and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
